system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy

Emplacement Points:  1

Size Restriction:  Colossal or Larger

Baffled Drives are favored by smugglers moving through dangerous, highly patrolled star systems and anyone else that needs to move through space with a modicum of stealth. A Baffled Drive uses supercooled Tibanna gas that leaves no visible trail, making it incredibly difficult to detect the ship with sensors. A Baffled Drive always gives a Starship a Starship Scale speed of 2 squares, and has a limited fuel capacity. A Starship's Baffled Drive can move the ship up to 100 squares (total) before it needs to be refueled; refueling a Baffled Drive has a base cost of 1400 credits (x Cost Modifier). A ship moving with a Baffled Drive adds +5 to the DC of any Perception or Use Computer check made to detect the ship, and if the ship has Sensor Baffling it can move up to twice its base speed in one turn without losing the benefit of the Sensor Baffling.
